title: IDF Strikes Kill 3 Palestinians in Deir al-Balah, Zawayda, and Khan Younis
detail: Israeli forces carried out a wave of strikes across central and southern Gaza on June 2, 2026. One Palestinian was killed and four others wounded when an IDF airstrike struck a vehicle east of Deir al-Balah in central Gaza. In the nearby village of Zawayda, a second strike killed one Palestinian and wounded another. A third Palestinian man was shot dead by Israeli forces in northwest Khan Younis. The multi-location attack pattern — consistent with near-daily Israeli operations under the October 2025 ceasefire — was confirmed by the Times of Israel liveblog and Gaza medical sources who reported the casualties transferred to Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital and Nasser Hospital respectively. The strikes bring the documented post-ceasefire Palestinian death toll to approximately 933+, against 3,005+ Israeli violations documented by Gaza's Government Media Office as of May 27, 2026.

media.caption: IDF strikes kill 3 Palestinians across Gaza on June 2, 2026

title: IDF Kills Nukhba Force Deputy Commander Youssef Ramadan — Linked to Oct 7 Re'im Shelter Hostage Abductions — and Four Other Hamas/PIJ Operatives
detail: The IDF announced on June 2, 2026 that it had killed five Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in recent strikes across Gaza. The most significant target was Youssef Ayesh Awad Ramadan, a Nukhba Force deputy commander who personally participated in the October 7, 2023 hostage abductions at the Re'im bomb shelter — seizing Hersh Goldberg-Polin, Alon Ohel, Eliya Cohen, and Or Levy. The other operatives killed included Salem Qariqa (Hamas Shejaiya Battalion, explosives and sniper role), Saeed Shamali (Nukhba Force team commander), and Ahmad Khallas (Palestinian Islamic Jihad sniper platoon commander), along with two additional unnamed Hamas bomb-planting commanders. The IDF stated all five were planning imminent attacks on Israeli forces. The eliminations continue Israel's sustained attrition campaign against Hamas's Nukhba commando force, which led the October 7 ground assault, and against the broader Hamas command structure — in which two successive Qassam Brigades chiefs were killed on May 15 and May 26, 2026.

media.caption: IDF kills 5 Gaza operatives, including Nukhba Force deputy commander linked to Oct 7 Re'im shelter abductions

title: Netanyahu Has Tense Call With Trump Over Planned Beirut Strike; Welcomes New Mossad Chief Gofman; Israel-Lebanon Talks Open in Washington
detail: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu held a tense call with US President Donald Trump on June 2, 2026 over a planned Israeli airstrike on Hezbollah targets in Beirut. Trump urged Netanyahu to hold the strike, with Israel agreeing to defer provided it was not attacked first. The episode — reported by Times of Israel as 'Trump tells Netanyahu: Don't' — underscores the divergence between US pressure to contain the conflict and Israel's desire to act against Hezbollah as part of the broader Iran-axis campaign. Separately, Netanyahu held a welcoming ceremony for the new Mossad director, Roman Gofman, vowing to hasten the fall of Iran's regime. A fresh round of Israel-Lebanon talks began in Washington, DC on June 2, with the US mediating discussions on a longer-term border arrangement. Inside Israel's coalition, ultra-Orthodox parties UTJ and Shas threatened to withhold support for coalition legislation unless the Torah Study Basic Law was fast-tracked through the Knesset — deepening the government's instability ahead of expected October 2026 elections. Channel 12 polling (May 29) showed Netanyahu's bloc at 51 seats, 10 short of a majority.

media.caption: Trump tells Netanyahu 'Don't' on striking Beirut; Netanyahu welcomes new Mossad chief Gofman — June 2, 2026
